evidence.finding: The paper formulates fixed-budget spatial dropout allocation and tests it in a controlled finite-width critical MLP.
The curated score rule fixes mean dropout at0.1 and requires the remaining matched experimental settings unchanged.
The supported revised artifact uses25 replicas,75 epochs and batch100; these are experiment controls, while Step(early) is the replaceable allocation.
Original guard distinguishes declared configuration, fixed-network reconstruction and source-level training provenance.
